subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “Students measured river temperature at different points.”?
options: Water near shaded areas was cooler.
The painted areas stayed cooler than dark surfaces nearby.
They suggested planting trees, painting some roofs lighter, and adding shade near waiting areas.
Safety lights remained at important corners, but bright lights near the water were reduced.
